note: The together preset's spec (contractspec/subsets/together) against what the openai adapter decodes; see spec_allowlist.json for the official API. Its contract fixtures are the together@<model> directories under testdata/contracts.

unmapped.reason: known gap TG1: Together's reasoning (message.reasoning, which its reasoning models fill) is dropped; models.Message has reasoning_content, which Together also documents, but nothing maps reasoning to it
no canonical field: the call's position, which its place in tool_calls already gives
no canonical field: the sampling seed used, echoed per choice
no canonical field: a completions-style text Together's ChatCompletionChoicesData also allows; chat responses carry the text in message.content
known gap TG3: Together reports top_logprobs beside the choice (not inside logprobs as OpenAI does), and models.Choice has no slot for it, so requested top logprobs are dropped
known gap TG2: streamed reasoning (delta.reasoning) is dropped, as TG1
no canonical field: the sampled token's id
known gap O3: streamed choice logprobs are dropped (models.StreamChoice has no logprobs field), so a stream with logprobs: true carries none to the client
no canonical field: the sampling seed used, echoed per choice
known gap TG3: as on the non-stream path
no canonical field: models.ImageData has no index; the position in data gives it
no canonical field: whether the image is a url or b64_json, which the field set says
no canonical field: models.ImageResponse has no id, so a generated image cannot be traced in Together's logs
no canonical field: models.ImageResponse has no model; the request names it

opaque.reason: forwarded verbatim: the canonical type keeps this as raw JSON and the client receives it unchanged
the vector (a float array, or base64 text for encoding_format base64) is kept as raw JSON and forwarded unchanged

enums.reason: known gap TG4: Together's "eos" (end of sequence, its natural stop) passes through unmapped: it is not a canonical finish reason, so the inbound translators (Anthropic, Gemini) fall back to a default and clients that switch on finish_reason miss it. reportFinishReason reports it

kinds.reason: the stream's "[DONE]" sentinel, which the spec models as a string chunk; the parser ends the stream on it before decoding
Together types the index as a number; it is a position, an integer in practice. A fractional value would fail the chunk's decode (malformed_payload)
the spec types usage as UsageData or null via allOf, which flattens to any; it is an object or null
